heading: Fractional parts of a cent
lead: In the payment of any tax imposed by this title, a fractional part of a cent shall be disregarded unless it amounts to one-half cent or more, in which case it shall be increased to 1 cent.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1976—Pub. L. 94–455 struck out “not payable by stamp” after “title”.
